COG.note: Mandatory e-signature inside the procurement system is stated by decree only, with no service in use.

facts.fact: Decree 2024-2072 of 10 October 2024 establishes an electronic public procurement system (e-GP) run by the ARMP covering the cycle from programming to archiving, to be deployed in two phases, first among public actors and then with bidders included.

COG.note: The decree covers electronic public procurement only, not electronic transactions or online selling generally.
The document states nothing this study asks for COG.
